externalReference.availabilityPolicy: An explicitly configured GOZERO_ROOT must be a valid checkout at the exact pinned commit. Without an available pinned checkout the gate validates the tracked contract only and emits accepted=false; promotion requires the documented GOZERO_ROOT command.

proofPolicy.positioning: The oracle proves a migration path against pinned real goctl output. It does not claim a byte-for-byte goctl replacement or a matching runtime layout.
proofPolicy.generationPolicy: Each side receives an isolated source copy and output directory. The checked-out goctl source is used both to run goctl and as the explicit generated-project dependency replacement.
proofPolicy.compilationPolicy: Both generated modules run go mod tidy and go test ./... with disposable build and temporary directories; generated-project dependencies remain outside the gofly root module.
proofPolicy.httpPolicy: Each generated runtime is started on a loopback-only temporary port and receives the same fixture-defined HTTP request. The expected status, route, type, and configuration evidence must agree before promotion.
proofPolicy.failurePolicy: A bad pin, digest mismatch, generation failure, compilation failure, failed HTTP smoke, missing contract evidence, or unclassified diff is blocking when a pinned oracle is available. Layout and model-layout differences are classified evidence, not byte-parity failures.

promotionCriteria: Run GOZERO_ROOT=/path/to/pinned/go-zero make goctl-oracle-replay-check and retain the JSON report as the migration-review artifact.
Both representative fixtures must pass dual generation, compilation, route/type/config evidence, deterministic output, and HTTP smoke.
Review classified layout differences explicitly; do not turn them into a byte-for-byte parity claim.
Keep the source go-zero service routable until the migration change has passed the rollback recipe in from-go-zero-migration.md.
